description:
As a quality automation engineer
  I want to verify all authentication, boundary, validation, and security flows
  So that the login page behaves reliably and securely according to QA specifications

elements.name: TC-POS-01: Successful Login with Valid Credentials

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters valid username "admin" and password "Pass@9211"
user clicks the Sign In button
user should be redirected to the home dashboard URL "https://www.scriptedqa.com/home"
the welcome dashboard message "Welcome back, Automation Engineer!" should be visible
user navigates to the Login page
user enters valid username "admin" and password "Pass@9211"
user clicks the Sign In button
user should be redirected to the home dashboard URL "https://www.scriptedqa.com/home"
user clicks the Sign Out button
user should be redirected back to the Login page URL "https://www.scriptedqa.com/"
the username and password fields should be reset to blank
user navigates to the Login page
user enters username "admin" and password "Pass@9211"
user submits the login form using the Enter key
user should be redirected to the home dashboard URL "https://www.scriptedqa.com/home"

elements.name: TC-NEG: Login failure with invalid credentials - TC-NEG-01

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters username "admin" and password "WrongPass123!"
user clicks the Sign In button
the error message "Oops! The credentials are incorrect." should be displayed
user should remain on the Login page

elements.name: TC-NEG: Login failure with invalid credentials - TC-NEG-02

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters username "unknown_user" and password "Pass@9211"
user clicks the Sign In button
the error message "Oops! The credentials are incorrect." should be displayed
user should remain on the Login page

elements.name: TC-NEG: Login failure with invalid credentials - TC-NEG-03

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters username "" and password ""
user clicks the Sign In button
the error message "Oops! The credentials are incorrect." should be displayed
user should remain on the Login page

elements.name: TC-NEG: Login failure with invalid credentials - TC-NEG-04

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters username "Admin" and password "pass@9211"
user clicks the Sign In button
the error message "Oops! The credentials are incorrect." should be displayed
user should remain on the Login page
user navigates to the Login page
user enters username "a" and password "P"
user clicks the Sign In button
the error message "Oops! The credentials are incorrect." should be displayed
user should remain on the Login page

elements.name: TC-BND-02: Extreme Length Input String (255+ Characters)

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters an extreme length string of 300 characters into credentials fields
user clicks the Sign In button
the application should handle the long input without crashing and display error "Oops! The credentials are incorrect."
user should remain on the Login page

elements.name: TC-BND-03: Leading and Trailing Whitespaces Handling

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters username "  admin  " and password "  Pass@9211  "
user clicks the Sign In button
the error message "Oops! The credentials are incorrect." should be displayed
user should remain on the Login page
user navigates to the Login page
the password input field must have attribute "type" equal to "password"

elements.name: TC-VAL-02: Input Placeholder and Focus State Verification

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
the username input should display placeholder "Username"
the password input should display placeholder "Password"
user focuses on the username input field
the username input field should have active focus

elements.name: TC-SEC: Protection against unauthorized payloads - TC-SEC-01

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters security payload username "' OR '1'='1" and password "' OR '1'='1"
user clicks the Sign In button
the authentication attempt should be denied with error "Oops! The credentials are incorrect."
user should remain on the Login page

elements.name: TC-SEC: Protection against unauthorized payloads - TC-SEC-02

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user enters security payload username "" and password ""
user clicks the Sign In button
the authentication attempt should be denied with error "Oops! The credentials are incorrect."
user should remain on the Login page

elements.name: TC-SEC-03: Unauthenticated Direct URL Access Protection

steps.name: user navigates to the Login page
user attempts to navigate directly to protected route "https://www.scriptedqa.com/home" without authenticating
user should be redirected back to the Login page URL "https://www.scriptedqa.com/"

name: Scripted QA Login Page Functionality
